scope: Static aggregation of saved published A/B runs and artifact bytes; product code not executed.
oldC01: HOLD; current A/B preservation does not substitute for the missing old generator/input/Plan/revision set.

semanticComparisonPolicy.operationIdentifiers: Operation/session/job/worker/instance IDs and worker generation are run identities. Input/selection/plan revisions are revision counters. Original artifacts retain every original field.
semanticComparisonPolicy.jobOrder: Only sdkReport.jobs and sdkReport.ingestion.jobs are sorted by numeric jobId suffix before operation identities are removed; they record completion order. Functional report arrays retain their original order.
semanticComparisonPolicy.retained: All input hashes and Plan values, report findings, source positions, coverage, mapping, statuses, completeness, build/wasm identities, non-time metrics including all byte/input/arena counts and settings.
semanticComparisonPolicy.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, original array order except explicitly listed SDK job telemetry, compact separators and no non-finite numbers.
